title: 第二十三章：千篇一律的传说
content_zh:
其实这也是贺峰第一次到武堂这个地方来，直到今日他才知道，原来武堂的防守竟然真的很严密，严密到了自己这个少爷也要在老爷的陪同下，才能进去。

    一个很常见的规矩，却让贺峰开始兴奋，监管如此严密，难道里面真的藏有什么绝世秘籍？

    ••••••

    贺峰一如昨日，起床穿衣，然后洗漱，最后是出去晨练，这看似只是连续了几日的习惯，其实却是三十年来养成的习惯了，虽然中间有过一段较长时间的中断，但依然没有丝毫的改变，这是一种深入灵魂的惯性。

    贺峰从未觉得晨练是这么的无聊过，心情也开始少少的有些烦闷，看了看路两旁的花草，今天的天气有些雾，花草上面都还沾着些水汽，隐约间听到四下有人说话的声音，隐隐绰绰间看到有些个人影，但又看不清，望了望有些空旷的四周，总是觉得少了些什么。这种感觉，直到看到渐渐从后面跟上来的月儿，才稍稍缓了缓。

    见到父母，问候虽然简单，但也并不乏味，或许也只有在自己最亲的人面前，才能活出自己真正的简单的一面，而不用担心会受到任何的伤害。

    或许是因为饭前父亲说的那句，你的体质有些特殊，稍后到武堂再讲。使得贺峰有些心神不宁，特殊？怎么特殊？难道自己还真的像那些小说了写的那样，是一个废物，然后经过千辛万苦之后，终于称霸世界？但是自己的身体一直都很好啊，不禁无病无灾，而且在睡梦中，自己的体质也得到了明显的增强，更何况，自己可是连八岁的金灿都能打趴下的人，怎么可能是废物？

    自己事，自己知。这话说的一点不假，贺峰也知道自己的存在很特殊，特殊到所有人都无法理解，更无法解释，但自己特殊的地方难道不是应该在于灵魂吗？怎么会特殊在身体上呢？

    等待的时间总是特别的漫长，贺峰看了看外面尚未散尽的雾气，他觉得自己今天的心情总是特别容易低落，哪怕面前放着平时最爱吃的精致的小菜，也同样没有什么好胃口。

    “你知道吗？我武朝上国，地大物博，人杰地灵，但你可能不知道，在这个世界上，若是只有这些，是远远不够得到别人的尊敬的，如果想要得到别人的尊敬，甚至是敬畏，依靠最多的其实还是那些最顶尖的实力，也就是那些人们口中常说的那些惊才绝艳的天才神子般的人物。”贺烈站在武堂的窗口背负双手，仰望无限星空，满脸的自豪，竟好似他口中的那些天才神子就是自己一般。

    贺峰很平静的听着，他虽然有些意外贺烈和他说话的语气和说话的内容，但也并未放在心上。而且他虽然出生在武朝境内，而他也确实是一个武朝人，但他对武朝真的没什么归属感，更不要说什么一荣俱荣的自豪感了。在他的认知里，那些传说，以及传说中的天才神子，都不过是“别人家的孩子”，在根本上，和他哪怕半点关系也没有，自然就更不会有什么感觉了。

    贺烈并没有发现自己身后，兴致缺缺贺峰，依然自顾自的讲着那些传说。“在百多年前，武朝国力并不像现在这般强势，甚至因为魔人与妖族的入侵，还有其他的一些势力的一些不好的想法，使得武朝危机四伏，但是当时却很突然的出现了一个年轻人，他叫做容二，十五岁那年，第一次上榜，便是人榜首位，环顾四野，世人仰望，人榜首位，一座便是五年；而后二十岁那年首次战地磅，便又居于首位，再后来虽然他并没有去挑战天榜，但所有武朝的人都相信，只要他想，哪怕是天榜首位，也必是他的囊中之物，因为当年他曾带领武朝重新走向了辉煌，灭了大半魔人，退了妖族妖兵，震慑了所有觊觎武朝超然地位的人们，无人能挡，无人敢挡，自那之后，我武朝的国势才又开始慢慢慢的变强了起来，直至今天。”

    贺峰看着满脸迷醉的父亲，心想，真不是一个会讲故事的人，最起码要讲一些能够激动人心的战斗事例也好，现在倒好，就这样笼统不清的讲一遍，谁知道你讲的传说里，那个叫做容二的人到底有多么强大，难道一切要靠自己脑补？但是一个连什么是魔人，什么是妖族都不知道的人应该怎么脑补呢？

    贺烈转过身，看了看满脸呆滞的贺峰，很是满意的点了点头，他很满意自己讲的故事带来的震撼，心想，自己讲出来的画面果然太过震撼。

    “据传说，千百年前，在北方荒原有个年轻人，叫做独狼，刚出道便独闯四秘境，之后更是独入八方阁，九重塔，无人能挡，一人所向，虽千万人而不改。只是可惜，这个叫做独狼的少年，一样也没有去挑战天榜，便是连地磅都没有挑战，只是在十六岁那年，和人榜首位，似乎战了个平手。”
content_en:
In fact, this was also the first time He Feng came to Wutang. He didn't know until today that Wutang's defense was really tight. It was so tight that he, the young master, had to be accompanied by the master before he could enter.

A very common rule, but it made He Feng excited. With such strict supervision, could there really be some secret secret hidden in it?

••••••

Just like yesterday, He Feng got up and got dressed, then washed up, and finally went out for morning exercise. This seemed to be a habit that lasted only a few days, but in fact it was a habit developed over the past thirty years. Although there was a long interruption in the middle, there was still no change at all. This is an inertia that goes deep into the soul.

He Feng had never felt that morning exercise was so boring, and he began to feel a little bored. He looked at the flowers and plants on both sides of the road. It was a bit foggy today, and the flowers and plants were still covered with some moisture. He vaguely heard the sound of people talking around, and vaguely saw some figures, but couldn't see them clearly. Looking around the somewhat empty surroundings, he always felt that something was missing.This feeling only eased a little when I saw Yue'er gradually coming up from behind.

Although the greetings when meeting parents are simple, they are not boring. Perhaps only in front of the people closest to you can you live your true simple side without worrying about being hurt in any way.

Maybe it’s because of what my father said before the meal, you have a special physique, we’ll talk about it later in the martial arts hall.It made He Feng a little uneasy, special?How special?Could it be that I was really a waste like those novels said, and then after going through a lot of hardships, I finally dominated the world?But my body has always been very good. I can't help but feel free from illness and disaster, and my physique has also been significantly enhanced in my sleep. What's more, I can knock down even eight-year-old Jin Can. How can I be a waste?

It's your own business, you know it yourself.This is true. He Feng also knows that his existence is very special, so special that no one can understand it, let alone explain it. But shouldn't his specialness lie in his soul?Why is it special about the body?

The waiting time was always extremely long. He Feng looked at the fog outside that had not yet dissipated. He felt that his mood was always low today. Even if his favorite exquisite side dishes were placed in front of him, he still had no appetite.

"Did you know? My country is vast, rich in resources, and has outstanding people. But you may not know that in this world, if you only have these, it is far from enough to gain the respect of others. If you want to gain the respect, or even the awe, of others, the thing you rely on most is actuallyThose who are at the top of their game are those people who are astonishingly talented and like geniuses." He Lie stood at the window of the martial arts hall with his hands behind his back, looking up at the infinite starry sky, with pride on his face, as if the geniuses he mentioned were himself.

He Feng listened calmly. Although he was a little surprised by the tone and content of He Lie's words to him, he didn't take it to heart.And although he was born in Wu Dynasty, and he is indeed a Wu Dynasty person, he really has no sense of belonging to Wu Dynasty, let alone the pride of being prosperous and prosperous.In his opinion, those legends and the legendary genius son of God are just "other people's children". Fundamentally, they have nothing to do with him at all, and naturally they have no feelings at all.

He Lie didn't notice that he was behind him. He Feng was not interested and was still telling the legends to himself."More than a hundred years ago, the Wu Dynasty's national power was not as strong as it is now. Even because of the invasion of demons and demons, as well as some bad ideas from other forces, the Wu Dynasty was in danger. But at that time, a young man named Rong Er suddenly appeared. When he was fifteen years old, he was at the top of the list for the first time. Looking around, the world looked up, and he stayed at the top of the list for five years; and then when he was twenty years old, he competed on the scale for the first time, and he ranked first.Although he did not challenge the Tianbang, everyone in the Wu Dynasty believed that if he wanted to, even the top of the Tianbang would be within his grasp, because he had led the Wu Dynasty back to glory.After destroying most of the demons and retreating the demon soldiers, all those who coveted the Wu Dynasty’s transcendent status were unstoppable and no one dared to stop me.From then on, our Wu Dynasty’s national power began to slowly become stronger again, until today.”

He Feng looked at his father who was intoxicated and thought to himself, he is really not a good storyteller. At least he should tell some exciting battle examples. It would be better now, just tell it in a general way. Who knows how powerful the person named Rong Er is in the legend you told? Do you have to rely on your own imagination to figure everything out?But how should a person who doesn’t even know what a devil is or what a monster is supposed to think about?

He Lie turned around, looked at He Feng who had a dull face, and nodded with satisfaction. He was very satisfied with the shock of the story he told, and thought to himself that the picture he told was really too shocking.

"According to legend, thousands of years ago, there was a young man named Lone Wolf in the northern wasteland. He broke into the Four Secret Realms alone when he first debuted. After that, he entered the Eight Directions Pavilion and the Nine-Storey Tower alone. No one could stop him. He did what he wanted, even though there were thousands of people. It was a pity that this young man named Lone Wolf did not challenge the Heavenly Ranking. He did not even challenge the ground scale. At the age of sixteen, he seemed to have a tie with the top of the ranking."
